prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE landscape 16:9 first story illustration / STYLE TEST for a videogame, not a collage and no text.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is Gabriel's CHARACTER IDENTITY only, a 3D character to translate into drawing. Images 2 and 3 are the DRAWING STYLE references, including imperfect black pencil outlines, rough grainy pastel colouring and awkward amateur anime anatomy. Image 4 is Gora-P LOCOMOTIVE identity only, useful for simple cabin colours; do NOT render 3D or draw a second train outside.
Gabriel is an adult wingless archangel woman, warm tan skin, long tousled wavy pale golden/platinum blonde hair with curled fringe and a small cowlick, pale grey-green eyes, casual gyaru/gal attitude. Preserve image1 outfit: loose white short-sleeved sailor blouse with dark slate sailor collar, orange plaid necktie, slate pleated skirt with an orange plaid side panel, chunky bead bracelets. No wings, animal ears, horns, or invented head accessories.
Scene: Gabriel INSIDE her locomotive's cabin in heaven, seen waist-up at a SIMPLE control desk, exasperated because another alarm has sounded. One elbow resting on desk, cheek in one hand, other hand on a large simple lever. Tired annoyed half-lidded eyes, raised eyebrow, small complaining open mouth, small rough horizontal blush/scratch marks on cheeks. One small ringing bell on wall with a couple of drawn motion marks. A large cabin window shows ONLY a flat pale cyan sky and two crudely drawn cream clouds. No locomotive visible through that window, because she is inside it. Simple pale pink window frame and a tiny cat-shaped motif on dashboard connect to Gora-P without creating another character.
STYLE IS CRITICAL: look like an inexperienced hobbyist attempting the examples, NOT professional concept art. Slightly uneven head/shoulders, stiff simple pose, wobbly broken black pencil contours, mismatched eyes, U-shaped simplified pupils like the examples, basic hands, chunky loosely drawn hair clumps, flat soft pastel colour with uneven grainy fill and a few scribbled yellow hair highlights. Same rough line and colouring treatment for Gabriel, desk, window, bell and all background props. No smooth gradients, no cinematic lighting, no shiny eyes, no airbrushed skin, no realistic material textures, no intricate controls, no intricate plaid, no polished anime rendering. Sparse flat background, small palette cream/blonde, orange, slate, pastel pink/cyan. Keep the character readable and recognisable as image1. Main subject upper 80 percent with a modest quiet lower margin for future dialogue. No captions, speech bubbles, letters, numbers, signature or watermark.
